title: Single Cell Calling Cards Library Preparation
author: Arnav Moudgil
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xwifpce
materials: Anneal scCC adapters in a thermocycler using the following settings: 95ºC for 5 minutes 70ºC for 15 minutes Ramp down to 25ºC as slowly as possible 25ºC for 5 minutes 4ºC forever scCC adapters can be kept on ice until needed. Adapters should be prepared fresh. NEBuffer 2 contains magnesium salts which can promote DNase activity, leading to degradation of adapters.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Isolation
steps.instruction: Prepare cells for isolation and encapsulation in gel bead emulsions (GEMs).

substeps.instruction: For piggyBac transposase with PB-SRT-Puro transposons: dissociate and resuspend cells that survived selection.
For piggyBac with PB-SRT-tdTomato: use FACS to isolate tdTomato-positive cells, using cells transfected with PB-SRT-tdTomato alone as a gating control.

steps.title: GEM Generation and Barcoding
steps.instruction: Perform GEM Generation & Barcoding following 10x instructions with specific modifications.

substeps.instruction: Step 1.1: Replace the RT Primer with an equivalent volume of Low TE Buffer.
Proceed with Steps 1.2–1.5 (loading Single Cell 3' chip, running controller, transferring GEMs, and reverse transcription).
Incubate RT reaction: 53 °C for 45 min, 53 °C for 5 min, 85 °C, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Clean GEM-RT Mixture
steps.instruction: Clean the GEM-RT mixture using Recovery Agent and DynaBeads MyOne Silane per 10x instructions.

substeps.instruction: At the final elution stage, add 36.5 µl Elution Solution I to the tube, mix by pipetting, and incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Place tube in 10x Magnetic Separator in the Low position until the solution turns clear.
Transfer 36 µl of the eluted sample to a new tube.

steps.title: Divide Eluate for Parallel Libraries
steps.instruction: Divide the 36 µl eluate into two 18-µl aliquots. Store at –20ºC if not used immediately.

substeps.instruction: Assign one aliquot for scRNA-seq library preparation.
Assign the other aliquot for scCC library generation.

steps.title: Prepare scRNA-seq Libraries
steps.instruction: Add template switch oligonucleotide to the first strand synthesis products.

substeps.instruction: Thaw one 18 µl aliquot on ice.
Prepare 1X master mix: 20 µl Maxima 5X RT buffer, 20 µl 20% w/v Ficoll PM-400, 10 µl 10 mM dNTPs, 2.5 µl RNaseOUT, and 2.5 µl 100 µM 10x_TSO.
Add 18 µl of first strand RT product and 22 µl H2O to the mix.
Add 5 µl Maxima H– RTase, flick to mix, and centrifuge briefly.
Incubate: 25 °C for 30 min, 50 °C for 1.5 hours, and 85 °C for 5 min.
Perform post GEM-RT Cleanup following 10x protocol, starting from the addition of DynaBeads MyOne Silane (Step 2.1, part D).
Complete cDNA amplification and library construction per 10x instructions (Steps 2.2–3.7).
Record the sample index used for final PCR.
Quantitate library using a 1:10 dilution on an Agilent TapeStation High Sensitivity D1000 ScreenTape.

steps.title: Amplify Self-Reporting Transcripts (SRT)
steps.instruction: Amplify SRTs from the second 18 µl aliquot of first-strand synthesis product.

substeps.instruction: Thaw the 18 µl aliquot on ice.
Prepare PCR primer cocktail: 5 µl 100 µM Bio_Illumina_Seq1_scCC_10X_3xPT primer, 5 µl 100 µM Bio_Long_PB_LTR_3xPT primer, and 10 µl Low TE Buffer. Vortex and spin down.
Prepare PCR mix: 25 µl 2X Kapa HiFi Hotstart Readymix, 18 µl first-strand synthesis product, 6 µl ddH2O, and 1 µl PCR primer cocktail. Keep on ice.
Perform PCR: 98ºC for 3 min; 20 cycles of (98ºC for 20s, 67ºC for 30s, 72ºC for 5 min); 72ºC for 10 min; 4ºC hold. (Note: If uncertain, use 9 µl template and reserve 9 µl for additional cycles).

steps.title: Purify SRT PCR Products
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR mixture using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend AMPure XP beads by vortexing and bring to room temperature for 30 min.
Add 30 µl beads to 50 µl PCR mixture (0.6x ratio), mix by pipetting 10 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place on magnetic rack for 5 min, aspirate and discard supernatant.
Add 200 µl 70% ethanol, incubate ≥ 30 seconds, aspirate and discard supernatant. Repeat this wash once more.
Air dry pellet at room temperature for 2 min.
Add 40 µl QIAGEN Elution Buffer, mix by pipetting, and incubate off the rack for 5 min.
Place on magnetic rack for 5 min or until clear; transfer supernatant to a new 1.7 ml tube.

steps.title: Quantitate SRT Eluate
steps.instruction: Quantitate the purified SRT eluate to determine molar concentration.

substeps.instruction: Make a 1:10 dilution (1 µl eluate in 9 µl ddH2O).
Quantitate on TapeStation High Sensitivity D5000 ScreenTape (measure 250 bp to 7000 bp).
Target concentration: Original eluate should be at least 7.5 nM (diluted sample ≥ 750 pM). If too low, increase PCR extension cycles using reserved template.
Thaw CB – Circularization Buffer 10X on ice.
Prepare reaction in a 1.7 ml tube: 300 fmol self-reporting transcripts (calculate volume based on nM concentration; approx. 200 ng), ddH2O up to 268 µl, 30 µl CB, and 2 µl Circularization Ligase.
Mix by flicking, spin down, and incubate at 30 °C overnight (12-16 hours).
Add 9 µl PS1 – Exonuclease directly to the overnight circularization mixture.
Flick to mix, spin down, and incubate: 37 °C for 30 min, then 70 °C for 30 min.
Add 12 µl STL – Stop Ligation Buffer, flick to mix, and centrifuge gently.

steps.title: Prepare Adapters and Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the scCC adapters and streptavidin-coated magnetic beads while exonuclease is incubating.

substeps.instruction: Anneal scCC adapters in a PCR tube: 4.5 µl scCC_P5_adapter (100 µM), 4.5 µl scCC_P7_adapter (100 µM), and 1 µl NEBuffer 2.
Prepare beads: Resuspend Dynabeads M-280 by vortexing, add 300 µl BBB, and store at room temperature.
Transfer 20 µl beads to a clean 1.7 ml tube.
Place on magnetic rack for 1 min, aspirate and discard supernatant.
Add 40 µl BBB – Bead Bind Buffer, incubate 1 min, aspirate and discard supernatant. Repeat once.

steps.title: Shear DNA and Bind to Beads
steps.instruction: Shear the DNA and bind it to the prepared beads.

substeps.instruction: Shear DNA on a Covaris ultrasonicator (e.g., E220).
Transfer sample to a new 1.7 ml tube and add 300 µl of bead solution.
Incubate at 20 °C for 15 min (shake at 1000 RPM on thermoshaker or flick every 2 min).
Centrifuge briefly (5-10s), place on magnetic rack for 1 min, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Bead Washing and End Repair
steps.instruction: Wash beads and perform end repair of the sheared DNA.

substeps.instruction: Wash 4 times with BWB – Bead Wash Buffer: Add 200 µl BWB, flick, spin down, place on rack for 30s, and discard supernatant.
Wash 2 times with RSB – Resuspension Buffer: Add 200 µl RSB, flick, spin down, place on rack for 30s, and discard supernatant (keep second wash supernatant until master mix is ready).
Discard all supernatant, centrifuge briefly, place on rack, and aspirate residual supernatant with a 10 µl pipette.
Prepare 1X End Repair Master Mix: 40 µl ERP3 – End Repair Mix and 60 µl ddH2O.
Add 100 µl End Repair reaction mix, remove from rack, flick, and centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at 30 °C for 30 min (shake at 1000 RPM on thermoshaker).
Centrifuge briefly (5-10s), place on magnetic rack for 1 min, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: A-Tailing and Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Perform A-tailing and ligate the annealed scCC adapters.

substeps.instruction: Wash 4 times with BWB (200 µl each, 30s on rack).
Wash 2 times with RSB (200 µl each, 30s on rack).
Discard all supernatant, centrifuge briefly, place on rack, and aspirate residual supernatant with a 10 µl pipette.
Prepare 1X A-Tailing Master Mix: 12.5 µl ATL2 – A-Tailing Mix and 17.5 µl ddH2O.
Add 30 µl A-Tailing reaction mix, remove from rack, flick, and centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 min (shake at 1000 RPM on thermoshaker).
Add to the A-tailing mix: 2.5 µl LIG2 – Ligation Mix, 4 µl ddH2O, and 1 µl annealed scCC adapter. Flick and centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at 30 °C for 10 min.
Add 5 µl STL – Stop Ligation Buffer and flick to mix.

steps.title: Final Library PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the ligated libraries via PCR.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge briefly (5-10s), place on magnetic rack for 1 min, and discard supernatant.
Wash 4 times with BWB (200 µl each, 30s on rack).
Wash 2 times with RSB (200 µl each, 30s on rack).
Discard all supernatant, centrifuge briefly, place on rack, and aspirate residual supernatant with a 10 µl pipette.
Prepare 1X PCR master mix: 20 µl EPM – Enhanced PCR Mix, 28 µl ddH2O, 1 µl scCC_P5_primer (25 µM), and 1 µl scCC_P7_primer (25 µM).
Add 50 µl PCR reaction mix to the sample, pipette to mix, and transfer to PCR tubes.
Incubate: 98ºC for 30s; 15 cycles of (98ºC for 10s, 60ºC for 30s, 72ºC for 2 min); 72ºC for 5 min; 4ºC hold. (Increase cycles to max 17 if starting material was < 300 fmol).

steps.title: Final Library Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the final scCC library using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend AMPure XP beads by vortexing and bring to room temperature for 30 min.
Place PCR tubes on magnetic rack for 1 min and transfer 50 µl supernatant to new tubes.
Add 35 µl beads to 50 µl PCR mixture (0.7x ratio), flick to mix, and centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place on magnetic rack for 5 min, aspirate and discard supernatant.
Add 200 µl 70% ethanol, incubate ≥ 30 seconds, aspirate and discard supernatant. Repeat once.
Air dry pellet at room temperature for 2 min.
Add 25 µl RSB – Resuspension Buffer, mix by pipetting, and incubate off the rack for 5 min.
Place on magnetic rack for 5 min or until clear; transfer supernatant to a new 1.7 ml tube.
Make a 1:10 dilution of the eluate.
Quantitate on TapeStation High Sensitivity D1000 ScreenTape (measure 200 bp to 1300 bp).
Verify library is smooth and unimodal, peaking between 500-700 bp.
